preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be greater than 1 and less than 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The string S must consist only of the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the string representation of the number of substrings with more 1s than 0s.
